1\. Configure Meet Alfred

source_message.text: Automated campaigns only help grow the network. To generate appointments, we need to engage in manual conversations.

ambiguity.description: The client prefers retaining MeetAlfred automation unless there is a solid alternative, while the freelancer advocates manual campaign activity and conversations for lead and appointment generation; the client has not resolved the campaign-mode choice.
